# tests/fixtures/art/

Art fixtures for `tests/ui/test_art_loading.gd`: a PNG beside an SVG of the same name (`loader/`), a 4x figure and a scale-2 boss with a manifest and bounds (`figures/`), apex and specialization figures for the fallbacks, and a portrait.

## Folders

| Folder | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `figures/` | A 4x hero figure, a scale-2 boss, apex and specialization figures, their manifest, and their bounds. |
| `loader/` | A PNG beside an SVG of the same name, and an SVG alone. |
| `portraits/` | A portrait for the 4x fixture hero. |
